parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the DescribeInstances operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user from whom you want to revoke the permissions on databases and database accounts.

> You can call the [ListUsers](~~204522~~) operation to query the ID of the user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-database-accounts-from-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-pe335ipfk01 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"8","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
